test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: The profit obtained by a vendor on selling goods at Rs. 3,200 is equal to 7/5th of the profit obtained by selling the same goods at Rs. 3,000. What is the cost price (in Rs.) of the goods?
solution:
**Given:**

Selling price at Rs. 3,200 and profit = 7/5 of the profit at Rs. 3,000

**Formula Used:**

Let profit at Rs. 3,000 be P, then profit at Rs. 3,200 = 7/5P

**Calculation:**

Let the cost price be C.

Profit at Rs. 3,000 = 3000 - C ⇒ P = 3000 - C

Profit at Rs. 3,200 = 3200 - C ⇒ 7/5P = 3200 - C

Substitute for P:

7/5 × (3000 - C) = 3200 - C

⇒ 4200 - 7C/5 = 3200 - C

⇒ 4200 - 3200 = 7C/5 - C

⇒ 1000 = (7C - 5C)/5

⇒ 1000 = 2C/5

⇒ C = 1000 × 5 / 2

⇒ C = 2500

**The cost price of the goods is Rs. 2,500.**
